# rook-ceph-blueprint

Krateo blueprints for Rook (v1.21.2) and a Ceph cluster for OpenStack. rook-operator vendors Rook's release manifests
(crds.yaml, common.yaml, operator.yaml at the tag) unchanged and renders them with a short, gated list of changes.
rook-ceph-cluster renders only Rook custom resources: CephCluster, CephBlockPool, CephClient, plus the read grant the
OpenStack blueprint's key copies need. Published to oci://ghcr.io/krateo-blueprints/charts/rook-operator and
.../rook-ceph-cluster on the blueprints channel.

## Shape
- blueprints/<chart>/chart, blueprints/<chart>/compositiondefinition.yaml.
- hack/upstream.yaml: the Rook tag, each vendored file's path and SHA-256, the operator image and container.
- hack/openstack-contract.yaml: what krateo-openstack-blueprint reads (pools, clients, Rook's Secrets, its ServiceAccount).

## Render-time changes to upstream (rook-operator)
- no Namespace object; every namespace: rook-ceph field becomes the release namespace;
- helm.sh/resource-policy: keep on every CRD;
- no CSI: ROOK_CREATE_CSI_OPERATOR_RESOURCES "false", no csi.ceph.io objects;
- ROOK_LOG_LEVEL and the operator's image, pull policy, resources, nodeSelector, tolerations from values.

## Preconditions (rook-ceph-cluster)
- Rook's CRDs served, and the rook-ceph-osd ServiceAccount in its namespace (install it where rook-operator is).
